specification.title: Stale Assessment races fail under lock
specification.description: Stale Assessment race: report input is materialized against Assessment A, then the Investigation advances to Assessment B before persistence. The report append must revalidate under lock and fail with the typed stale-input conflict; no report row, history, or pointer update may commit.
specification.purpose: Verify the report append revalidates the Assessment generation under lock and fails with the stale-input error when the Investigation advanced before persistence.
specification.operational_relevance: Concurrent investigations can race report generation; persisting a report against a stale Assessment corrupts the timeline.
specification.regression_risk: The writer could append a report materialized against a superseded Assessment.

required: The report append fails with the stale-input conflict error
No report is persisted against the superseded Assessment
forbidden: A report materialized from a stale Assessment is persisted
